topArticle.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad
topArticle.description:
Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights
With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.
On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.

topArticle.titleJa: 映像：クジラがヨットを破壊、救助後の安堵を語るカップル
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランド沖500マイルでヨットがマッコウクジラと衝突し破壊された夫婦が、救助後の安堵感を語った。

topArticle.title: Watch: Luxury prison in Indonesia demolished after public outcry
topArticle.description: Indonesian lawmakers on Wednesday ordered the demolition of a controversial luxury compound inside a penitentiary near the capital.
topArticle.titleJa: 映像：インドネシアの豪華刑務所、国民の反発を受け解体
topArticle.summary: インドネシアの国会議員が水曜日、首都近くの刑務所内にある物議を醸していた豪華施設を解体するよう命じた。国民の反発を受けての決定。

topArticle.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
topArticle.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行がアジア太平洋地域で「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブを開催
topArticle.summary: WTO、ADB、世界銀行がマニラで地域会議を開催し、「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域に導入。地域関係者がサービス貿易の役割と政策アプローチについて議論した。
